text:
miguel: hey all, accepted the org invite but i still see "Outside collaborator" on my profile and getting 403 on private repos. 2FA via authenticator app is enabled. invited to miguel.work@company.com but my GH primary email is miguel.personal@gmail.com.

[devex-bot]: GitHub Invite Event 1999999999: invite accepted for miguel. Note: org enforces SAML SSO and verified work email for full member access.

jamie: welcome! quick checklist: 1) add and verify your work email on GH (Settings -> Emails) 2) authorize SSO at https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso 3) if you were added as an Outside collaborator earlier we may need to convert you to Member.

miguel: added work email and verified, clicked Authorize SSO, but still shows Outside collaborator and infra repo returns 403.

peopleops-bot: Created ticket PO-5033 to reconcile outside collaborator -> member mapping for miguel. Please provide GH handle.

finn: post handle and i'll check team mapping. also check `gh api /user -q .emails` to confirm the verified emails list.

miguel: handle is miguel-rw. `gh api /user -q .emails` shows both emails and work email is verified.

finn: looks like the invite was sent before you added the work email so you were provisioned as an outside collaborator. i'll convert you to Member and add infra-team.

[devex-bot]: Onboarding automation: reconcile job queued for miguel-rw (job id: 92045).

finn: done — changed relationship to Member and added to team infra-team. waiting ~2 mins for GH sync. also FYI if you use Actions from forks, some workflows are blocked; for org runners we allow internal PRs.

miguel: refreshed 1999991015: can now access infra repo and clone. thanks! quick Q: when i run `gh auth status` it shows Authenticated but `gh auth token` shows limited scopes, will that block anything?

jamie: we use the `gh` CLI for a few tools that need repo read/write. if your token lacks scopes, run `gh auth login` and choose Web flow, then accept requested scopes. peopleops can also issue a PAT for automation if needed.

miguel: ran `gh auth login` and re-authorized. all good. thanks for the fast turnaround and welcome :)

peopleops-bot: PO-5033 updated: reconciliation complete. added note to onboarding runbook to re-check for invites sent to alternate emails to prevent future outside-collab cases.

jamie: welcome to the team! ping #eng-ops for any remaining setup hiccups.
